scripts.build: npm run build:headers && npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js
scripts.minify:css: postcss css/style.css -o css/style.css --no-map && postcss blog/css/blog.css -o blog/css/blog.css --no-map
scripts.minify:js: terser js/main.js -o js/main.js --compress --mangle && terser js/cookie-consent.js -o js/cookie-consent.js --compress --mangle
